kripalu.cha1: O mind, worship the gracious Śrī Rāmacandra, who takes away the dreadful fear of worldly existence. His eyes are like fresh lotuses; his face, his hands and his red feet are lotuses too. ।।1।।
kripalu.cha2: His boundless beauty outshines countless Kāmadevas; he is lovely as a fresh dark rain cloud. His yellow garment gleams like pure lightning. I bow to him, the husband of Janaka's daughter. ।।2।।
kripalu.cha3: Worship him, the friend of the lowly, radiant as the sun, destroyer of the lines of the demons; the joy of Raghu's house, the root of bliss, the moon of Kośala, the son of Daśaratha. ।।3।।
kripalu.cha4: A crown on his head, earrings, a tilaka on his brow; his fair, noble limbs adorned with ornaments. His arms reach to his knees; he bears bow and arrows, and conquered Khara and Dūṣaṇa in battle. ।।4।।
kripalu.cha5: Thus says Tulasīdāsa: O delight of the minds of Śaṅkara, Śeṣa and the sages, destroyer of the host of the wicked, lust and the rest, make your home in the lotus of my heart. ।।5।।
ramlala.tek: Perform the āratī of Śrī Rāmalalā, the child Rāma, perfect and skilled in the art of archery.
ramlala.cau1: Bow and arrows look beautiful in his hands; before his beauty the pride of millions of Kāmadevas fades. ।।1।।
ramlala.cau2: He is seated on a splendid throne, and at his left shines Vaidehī (Sītā). ।।2।।
ramlala.cau3: Śatrughna and Hanumān stand with folded hands; Bharata and Lakṣmaṇa serve him in many ways. ।।3।।
ramlala.cau4: Śiva, Brahmā and Nārada sing his many virtues; the Vedas say "not this, not this" and find no end to them. ।।4।।
ramlala.cau5: The whole world knows the power of his name; Śeṣa, Maheśa and Gaṇeśa praise it. ।।5।।
ramlala.cau6: He is the wish-granting tree of his devotees, himself wanting nothing, the home of compassion, forgiveness, mercy and every virtue. ।।6।।
ramlala.cau7: He made even Sugrīva king of the monkeys, and the Lord gave Vibhīṣaṇa a kingdom. ।।7।।
ramlala.cau8: As if in play he had the ocean bridged; his matchless fame spread over all the worlds. ।।8।।
ramlala.cau9: He slew the lord of Laṅkā, the fortress none could reach, and took away the fear of gods, men and sages. ।।9।।
ramlala.cau10: He set the gods back in their places, spread his fair fame, and raised up millions of the poor and fallen. ।।10।।
ramlala.cau11: Monkeys, the boatman, the bird (Jaṭāyu) and a demon (Vibhīṣaṇa): in his compassion he took away their sorrows and faults. ।।11।।
ramlala.cau12: He always honours his servants, so the monkey Hanumān became worshipped by the world. ।।12।।
ramlala.cau13: He always honoured the suffering and the lowly; all three worlds ring with "Victory to Rāma". ।।13।।
ramlala.cau14: Kausalyā and all the mothers, Daśaratha and all the Lord's devotees, ।।14।।
ramlala.cau15: gods, men and sages sing the Lord's virtues and find great joy in performing his āratī. ।।15।।
ramlala.cau16: With incense, lamp, sandal paste and food offered, and with a steady mind that keeps no division, (perform the āratī). ।।16।।
ramlala.cau17: Whoever sings the āratī of Rāmalalā gains, by Rāma's grace, the fruit he longs for. ।।17।।
ramchandra.tek: Perform the āratī of Rāmacandra, of Hari, the crusher of the wicked, the husband of Sītā.
ramchandra.pad1: The first āratī is a garland of flowers, to Gopāla, who tamed the serpent Kāliya and led him away. ।।1।।
ramchandra.pad2: The second āratī is to Devakī's son, the saviour of devotees and the slayer of Kaṁsa. ।।2।।
ramchandra.pad3: The third āratī is to him who enchants the three worlds; on a jewelled throne Sītā and Rāma shine. ।।3।।
ramchandra.pad4: The fourth āratī is the worship of all four ages: the stainless God alone is the Lord; there is no other. ।।4।।
ramchandra.pad5: The fifth āratī is dear to Rāma; Nāmadeva sings Rāma's glory. ।।5।।
